name: lobby-join-mid-game
description: A17 step 5: a third person joins while a ball is in play. They are sent HELLO_ACK and then the match's log in pages of 2, a few ms apart, so ball ends land between the HELLO_ACK and the last page: none of them reaches the newcomer live, all of them are in a later page, and the newcomer ends with the head everyone has.
